reproducibility_gaps: The exact NRC file inventory, versions, filenames, formats, sizes and checksums are not independently retrievable from the provider object interface used in this static verification.

The primary paper documents training/validation counts and generation procedures, but the exact repository-file mapping for potential classes, labels and train/validation partitions is not independently established.
No explicit dataset-level licence was independently verified; article copyright or repository-host terms are not transferred by inference.
The paper describes randomized data generation but does not report a seed sufficient to regenerate the exact random realization from the publication alone.
notes: R1 reflects an exact corrected data DOI, a verified paper relationship, a specific NRC repository object and substantial publication-level generation/use documentation.
R2 is withheld because the provider file/version manifest, paper-to-file mapping and dataset licence are not independently pinned.
